RICH~BOY~WINSTON sent out
Porygon and Honedge!

The opposing Honedge lost
some of its HP!
Arcanine was damaged by the recoil!

The opposing Porygon twisted
the dimensions!

The opposing Wooloo was hurt
by Snorlax’s Rocky~Helm

The opposing Wooloo was damaged
by the recoil!

The twisted dimensions
returned to normal!
